verdict.rationale: Pigment documents programmatic surfaces of its own: "open APIs", an Audit Trail API, and an official MCP server that claims you can "build and edit your Pigment model" from Claude, Cursor and Codex. That covers a meaningful slice of UI work outside the UI. Nothing in the pack claims or shows full API–UI parity, and no OpenAPI spec was found (all probed paths returned 404). missing for 10: an explicit API-parity claim, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec, documented API coverage of UI features such as dashboards, views, permissions, scenarios and comments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Build and edit your Pigment model directly from tools like Claude, Cursor, and Codex, without switching interfaces.
